title: Crows: The Battle Action for SegaSaturn
native_title: クローズ －ＴＨＥ ＢＡＴＴＬＥ ＡＣＴＩＯＮ ＦＯＲ ＳＥＧＡＳＡＴＵＲＮ－
overview: Crows: The Battle Action for SegaSaturn is a 2D street-brawling action game based on Hiroshi Takahashi's delinquent manga Crows, set around the rough students of Suzuran High School. Take control of tough guys such as Harumichi, Bitoh and Ryushin, drawn with big super-deformed heads, and fight your way through stage after stage of hoodlums and rival gangs. Before each stage you choose the kinds of combos you can use. A second player can join in and fight alongside you.
